question: Within the same prior SOXX 5/20-session return-sign state and first-trade calendar year, do weak and good 126-session exact-f696 windows differ in saved alpha/tail outputs, raw nominal beta, own-state risk cap, or funded beta?

definitions.population: All 944 exact f696 A0 0bp Tiered sessions and all 819 contiguous 126-session windows; retain four calendar years including partial 2023/2026 and 16 quarters from the source card
definitions.weak_good: Window paired log excess versus SOXX below or above zero; ties kept separate
definitions.start_state: At the window's first trade, preceding signal-day Qlib SOXX close returns over 5 and 20 sessions, grouped by their signs into uptrend/rebound/pullback/decline
definitions.matched_cell: start_state x first-trade calendar year, retaining cells with at least one weak and one good window
definitions.comparison: For each matched cell and measure, weak mean minus good mean; report cell counts and the min-group-count-weighted descriptive average across matched cells; no threshold selection or significance claim

interpretation: Alpha/tail/raw beta are saved predecision outputs; own-state cap is account-dependent; ending beta and future returns are downstream diagnostics, not candidate features. Overlapping windows and outcome-defined groups prohibit causal or independent-validation claims.
stop: Stop if source SHA/NAS, Qlib calendar, 944/819 coverage, daily component closure, or predecision start-state mapping fails. Do not derive a policy threshold or add a candidate feature from this diagnostic alone.
